text_en: Why do the nations conspire, and the peoples plot in vain?
text_cn: 万邦为什么嚣张， 众民为什么妄想？

text_en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord and his anointed, saying,
text_cn: 世上列王群集一堂， 诸侯毕至聚首相商，反抗上主，反抗他的受傅者：

text_en: “Let us burst their bonds asunder, and cast their cords from us. ”
text_cn: “来！我们挣断他们的捆绑， 我们摆脱他们的绳缰！”

text_en: He who sits in the heavens laughs; the Lord has them in derision.
text_cn: 坐于天上者在冷笑， 我主对他们在热嘲。

text_en: Then he will speak to them in his wrath, and terrify them in his fury, saying,
text_cn: 在震怒中对他们发言， 在气焰中对他们喝道：

text_en: “I have set my king on Zion, my holy hill. ”
text_cn: “我已祝圣我的君王， 在熙雍我的圣山上。”

text_en: I will tell of the decree of the Lord : He said to me, “You are my son; today I have begotten you.
text_cn: 我要传报上主的圣旨： 上主对我说：“你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你。”

text_en: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage, and the ends of the earth your possession.
text_cn: 你向我请求， 我必将万民赐你作产业， 我必将八极赐你作领地。

text_en: You shall break them with a rod of iron, and dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel. ”
text_cn: 你必以铁杖将他们粉碎， 就如同打破陶匠的瓦器。

text_en: Now therefore, O kings, be wise; be warned, O rulers of the earth.
text_cn: 众王！你们现在应当自觉， 大地掌权者！你们应受教：

text_en: Serve the Lord with fear, with trembling
text_cn: 应以敬畏之情事奉上主， 战战兢兢向他跪拜叩首；

text_en: kiss his feet, or he will be angry, and you will perish in the way; for his wrath is quickly kindled. Happy are all who take refuge in him.
text_cn: 以免他发怒将你们灭于中途， 因为他的怒火发作非常快速。 凡一切投奔他的人真是有福。
